### Missing Features

Manual check for missing features via [Genecards](https://www.genecards.org).

```{python}
#| label: missing-Prkn

np.isin(
    ["Prkn", "PRKN", "AR-JP", "PARK2", "PDJ", "Parkin", "PARKIN"], adata_nafld.var_names
)
```

Not feasible for all symbols.
Use [HGNC](https://www.genenames.org) API to retrieve aliases.

```{python}
def get_aliases(symbol: str, aliases: dict):
  uri = f"https://rest.genenames.org/fetch/symbol/{symbol}"
  res = requests.get(uri, headers={"Accept": "application/json"})
  docs = res.json()["response"]["docs"]

  if res.ok and docs:
    aliases[symbol] = docs[0]["alias_symbol"]
  else:
    aliases[symbol] = False

  return aliases
```

```{python}
aliases = {}
for symbol in not_found:
  aliases = get_aliases(symbol, aliases=aliases)

aliases
```

```{python}
def sparse_median(X, axis=0):
    # Convert sparse format for better performance
    if axis == 0:
        if not sp.isspmatrix_csc(X):
            X = X.tocsc()
    else:
        if not sp.isspmatrix_csr(X):
            X = X.tocsr()

    # Get matrix dimensions
    n_rows, n_cols = X.shape
    size = n_rows if axis == 0 else n_cols

    # Prepare output array
    medians = np.zeros(n_cols if axis == 0 else n_rows)

    # For each column (or row)
    for i in range(medians.shape[0]):
        # Get the slice (column or row)
        if axis == 0:
            data = X[:, i].toarray().flatten()
        else:
            data = X[i, :].toarray().flatten()

        # Count zeros (they're not stored in sparse matrix)
        n_zeros = size - len(data[data != 0])

        # Add zeros back
        if n_zeros > 0:
            data = np.append(data, np.zeros(n_zeros))

        # Calculate median
        medians[i] = np.median(data)

    return medians
```

```{python}
mean_stst = np.asarray(reduced_stst.X.mean(axis=0)).flatten()
median_stst = sparse_median(reduced_stst.X, axis=0)

mean_sp_stst = np.asarray(spatial_stst.X.mean(axis=0)).flatten()
median_sp_stst = sparse_median(spatial_sp_stst.X, axis=0)
```

```{python}
mean_nafld = np.asarray(reduced_nafld.X.mean(axis=0)).flatten()
median_nafld = sparse_median(reduced_nafld.X, axis=0)

mean_sp_nafld = np.asarray(spatial_nafld.X.mean(axis=0)).flatten()
median_sp_nafld = sparse_median(spatial_sp_nafld.X, axis=0)
```

```{python}
df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "gene": reduced_stst.var_names,
        "mean_expr_stst": mean_stst,
        "mean_expr_spatial": mean_sp_stst,
    }
)

sns.scatterplot(data=df, x="mean_expr_stst", y="mean_expr_stst")
plt.plot(
    [0, max(df.mean_expr_stst.max(), df.mean_expr_spatial.max())],
    [0, max(df.mean_expr_stst.max(), df.mean_expr_spatial.max())],
    ls="--",
    color="gray",
)  # identity line
plt.xlabel("Mean Expression StSt")
plt.ylabel("Mean Expression ST")
plt.title("Gene-wise Expression Comparison")
plt.savefig(os.join.path(out_dir, "mean_expr_comparison_stst.png"))
plt.show()
```
